verdict.rationale: Galileo says users can build datasets from live production data, and its Experiments feature runs evaluations of prompts, models, and app code against well-defined inputs and chosen metrics. That covers both curating datasets from production and running offline evals against them, and dataset creation and experiment runs are also exposed via MCP. Missing for 10: a detailed first-party walkthrough of turning logged traces into dataset rows (the production-to-dataset claim comes from a marketing page), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can curate datasets from production traces and run offline evaluations against them

citations.quote: Build your datasets from synthetic, development, and live production data.
Experiments allow you to evaluate prompts, models, and your application code, using well-defined inputs, against metrics of your choice.
